label: First Name
description: Core identifier. First thing Romeo asks on every call. Required for Hawksoft client profile creation.

label: Last Name
description: Core identifier. Required for Hawksoft client profile creation.

label: Date of Birth
description: Primary rating factor. Maps to Hawksoft-to-TurboRater bridge.

label: Mailing Address
description: Determines garaging and rating territory. Portal should use address autocomplete.

label: Phone
description: Core contact field. May already be captured from voice agent call — shown in portal only if missing.

label: Email
description: Needed for quote presentation — JAMCO presents quotes via email. Also needed for follow-up and portal link delivery.

label: First Name
description: Romeo collects all household drivers on the initial call. Add another driver button adds a new driver card.

label: Last Name
description: Required for driver identification in household.

label: Date of Birth
description: Required for every driver in household. Each added driver requires Name + DOB + DL# at minimum.

label: Gender
description: Rating factor. Required for TurboRater driver record.

label: Relationship to Applicant
description: Required for TurboRater driver record (spouse, child, other).

label: Household Members / Additional Insureds
description: May include non-driving household members for excluded driver assessment.

label: Driver's License #
description: Not reliably captured by voice agent (AI fatigue concern). One of the portal's highest-value fields.

label: Year
description: Core vehicle identification. Romeo collects verbally for each car.

label: Make
description: Core vehicle identification. Romeo collects verbally for each car.

label: Model
description: Core vehicle identification. Romeo collects verbally for each car.

label: VIN
description: Hawksoft does VIN lookup to supplement vehicle data. Validate via NHTSA check digit. If customer doesn't have VIN Year/Make/Model is acceptable.

label: Vehicle Usage
description: Commute / Pleasure / Business. Romeo confirmed as collected field.

label: Garaging Address
description: Only if different from mailing address. Inferred from Hawksoft screen walkthrough.

label: Comprehensive Deductible
description: Romeo asks coverages on the initial call. Improves quote accuracy but TurboRater can default if missing.

label: Collision Deductible
description: Per-vehicle deductible. TurboRater can default if missing.

label: Roadside Assistance
description: Part of per-vehicle coverage options requested on initial call.

label: Towing
description: Part of per-vehicle coverage options requested on initial call.

label: Rental Reimbursement
description: Part of per-vehicle coverage options.

label: Date of Incident
description: Romeo collects tickets/accidents/claims as screening mechanism. Affects carrier eligibility and surcharges.

label: Incident Type
description: Type of ticket accident or claim. Used for risk screening.

label: Description
description: Free-text or structured date/description of the incident.

label: Current Carrier
description: Romeo asks on every first call. Critical for competitive positioning and prior insurance verification.

label: Current Coverage Limits
description: The deal-breaker field. Without this the agency quotes at minimums and loses the deal. BI limits at minimum; full coverage table ideal.

label: Current Premium
description: Customers are price-sensitive — knowing their current premium lets JAMCO position competitively.

label: Policy Expiration / Renewal Date
description: Determines urgency and shopping window.

label: Monthly Payment Amount
description: Helps with competitive positioning on monthly cost.

label: Payment Method
description: EFT or payment financing. Affects payment plan options presented.

label: Desired Liability Limits
description: TurboRater defaults to current if known. Low priority — Romeo and team set these during consultative finalization step.
